scenario: Debating the pros and cons of remote work
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika sana katika mazingira rasmi kusema kuhusu faida.
Kiongozi cha kuweka mawazo tofauti; hutumika mwanzo au katikati ya jina la jumla.
Katika mazingira haya maana yake ni 'tatizo'.
Hutumika kuelezea uwakilishi.
Mwishowe wa jumla maana yake ni 'lakini' au 'lakini'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: One clear benefit of remote work is that it can increase your productivity, don't you think?
dialogue.translation: Moja kati ya faida waziwazi za kazi ya mbali ni kwamba inaweza kuongeza utendaji wako, je, hutafikiri?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true for some people. However, I've noticed several issues with it.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni kweli kwa watu fulani. Lakini, nimeona tatizo kadhaa na hilo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What kind of issues? I think most problems are similar to those you'd face in an office.
dialogue.translation: Aina gani za tatizo? Nafikiri tatizo zote ni sawa na wale ungewahi kuwepo katika ofisi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, remote work may require a lot of self-discipline. If you don't manage your time well, you'll likely fall behind.
dialogue.translation: Vyema, kazi ya mbali inaweza hitaji utamaduni mkubwa wa kujitolea. Ikiwa hutaendelea muda wako vyema, inawakilisha utakapokuwa nyuma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see your point. But companies should provide proper training and tools to help employees, though.
dialogue.translation: Nimeona sehemu yako. Lakini kampuni zinapaswa kutoa mafunzo na zana za kusaidia wafanyakazi, ingawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, they should. Therefore, it's not just about the employee's effort; the employer also has a role.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, wanapaswa. Kwa hiyo, si kuhusu juhudi la mtu tu; mtu anayetoa kazi nafasi pia ina jumla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. And I believe the flexibility remote work offers is a huge benefit that many people value.
dialogue.translation: Kabisa. Na naimanini uwezo wa kubadilika kazi ya mbali inatoa ni faida kubwa ambayo watu wengi huheshimu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree, as long as we address the issues we mentioned. Then it can work well for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Nana ujumbe, kwa muda mrefu tunapoelezea tatizo tulizoziona. Ndipo inaweza kufanya vizuri kwa kila mtu.

key_phrases.translation: Moja kati ya faida waziwazi za

scenario: Discussing a complex ethical dilemma
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika na majina: avoid doing something.
Katika mazingatio huu, inamaanisha sababu au kanuni ambayo inafanya mtu kufanya kilele chochote.
Inamaanisha uchaguzi kati ya mawazo mawili au zaidi.
Pia inaweza kutumika kama kisemi: to concern = kushughulisha.
Mara nyingi inatokana na majina: consider doing something.
Inatokana na jina au majina, si na habari inayojulikana na fisadi.
Inahusiana na utu au kanuni za kiutu.
Inamaanisha kushindwa kuweka fikra au kushikamana na kitu chochote.
Mara nyingi inatumika na majina: involve doing something.
Neno la kifano la 'result', lakini ni zaidi ya kawaida katika mazingatio ya rasmi au ya matokeo.
Inaweza kuwa ya kimwili au ya kifigurativo (ubunifu wa kijamii, wa kazi, n.k.).
Mwishowe wa habari inamaanisha 'lakini' au 'ingawa'. Usijaribu kufahamu na kuweka kwa fisadi 'though'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to decide whether to expose the company's mistake, even though it could cause a huge scandal.
dialogue.translation: Tunahitaji kuchagua kama tutazoa makosa ya kampuni, ingawa inaweza kufanya ubunifu mkubwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a serious ethical concern. But first, let's consider the outcome of each possible choice.
dialogue.translation: Hii ni jambo la kushangaza la kiutu. Lakini kwanza, tuwaze matokeo ya kila uchaguzi unaweza kutumika.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If we ignore it, we might avoid immediate problems, but the long-term damage to our reputation could be worse.
dialogue.translation: Ikiwa tutakikataa, tunaweza kuepuka matatizo ya mara moja, lakini hasira ya muda mrefu kwa jina letu inaweza kuwa mbaya zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. Yet the pressure from the board to keep this quiet is intense. They don't want any legal trouble, despite the risk.
dialogue.translation: Kweli. Hata hivyo, ubunifu kutoka kwa baraza kuhusu kuweka kama siri ni kubwa. Hawataka tatizo lolote la sheria, ingawa kuna hatari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but our decision should not involve hiding facts that affect public safety. That would be wrong.
dialogue.translation: Ninaelewa, lakini uchaguzi wetu haupaswi kuweka kuficha habari zinazohusiana na usalama wa umma. Hii ingekuwa makosa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree. Still, we need to think about the employees who might lose their jobs if we go public. It's a tough dilemma.
dialogue.translation: Nina ufanisi. Hata hivyo, tunahitaji kufikiri kuhusu wafanyakazi ambao wanaweza kupoteza kazi zao ikiwa tutazozima. Ni tatizo kubwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. But supporting the right cause sometimes means accepting some collateral damage. We can't just please everyone, though.
dialogue.translation: Ndivyo hivyo. Lakini kushikamana na sababu ya kweli mara nyingine inamaanisha kubaliwa na hasira fulani za kawaida. Hatwezi kuwafurahisha wote, lakini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's present both sides to the board and let them decide, but we'll make sure our recommendation is clear.
dialogue.translation: U kweli. Tuzoee upande mawili kwa baraza na watafute uchaguzi, lakini tutaweka uhakika kwamba ushauri wetu ni wazi.

scenario: Analyzing the impact of social media on society
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kudinisha athari au mabadiliko kwenye jambo fulani.
Ina maana utendaji wa watu.
Kikundi cha watu wenye mashirika au matumaini ya kawaida.
Taarifa zilizopatikana, mara nyingi katika fomu ya kijamii.
Matokeo au madhara ya jambo fulani.
Kudinisha jambo ambalo ni muhimu zaidi au linahusisha.
Kuna uwezo mkubwa wa kutokea.
Rahisi ya kufahamika au kuelezewa.
Ambao ni njema au ina faida.
Zaidi ya mbili lakini si nyingi.
Ina uhusiano na jamii au mawazo kati ya watu.
Inatumika mwisho wa jambo kudinisha tofauti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you think social media has a positive effect on our community?
dialogue.translation: Je, unadhani mitandao ya kijamii ina athari bora kwenye jamii yetu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It can, especially when people share useful information, but it also affects our behavior in several ways.
dialogue.translation: Inaweza, hasa wakati watu wanashiriki taarifa bora, lakini pia inaathiri tabia zetu kwa njia nyingi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And have you seen the data that shows how much time people spend on these platforms?
dialogue.translation: Na je, umeona data inayoonesha muda mwingi watu wanapita kwenye vyombo hivi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it's obvious that we're more connected than ever, though sometimes that connection feels superficial.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, ni wazi kwamba sisi ni zaidi ya kuwepo, lakini mara nyingine uhusiano huo unajisikia kuwa wa kijani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, do you think the overall effect is likely to be more harmful than helpful?
dialogue.translation: Hivyo, je, unadhani athari ya jumla inasemekana kuwa zaidi ya kudhara kuliko kusaidia?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. It depends on how we use it. For example, it can be a great tool for organizing social movements.
dialogue.translation: Sijui. Inategea jinsi tunavyotumia. Kwa mfano, inaweza kuwa chanzo bora kwa kushiriki mikusanyiko ya kijamii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But it also spreads misinformation quickly, which can affect public opinion in a negative way.
dialogue.translation: Lakini pia inaeneza uongo kwa haraka, ambayo inaweza kuharibu maoni ya umma kwa njia mbaya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. So we need to be critical and not just accept everything we see. That's the key, though.
dialogue.translation: Ndio hivyo. Hivyo tunahitaji kuwa wenye kushtaka na si kuelewa kila kitu tunachokiona. Hii ni ufunguo, lakini.

scenario: Presenting a business proposal
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mpango rasmi au maoni.
Kiwango cha fedha kilichopatikana kwa mradi.
Katika biashara, mara nyingi hufanya maana jamii kusudi au lengo.
Mpango wa hatua kufikia lengo.
Kufikia lengo kwa mafanikio.
Kuhakikisha jambo ladayeni.
Kubwa au inayofahamika kwa kutosha kufanya maana.
Inayoweza kutokea siku ijayo; mara nyingi hutumika kwa wageni au hatari.
Inayotokea sasa; halijapita.
Hutumiwa kutoa maana ya usambazaji au uhusiano ndani ya kikundi.
Huanza tofauti au kubali.
Hutoa matokeo au ufaidhumzi wa mantiki.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm here to present our proposal for the new marketing campaign.
dialogue.translation: Asubuhi njema, wote. Nimekuja hapa kuwasilisha maoni yetu kwa kampeni mpya ya biashara.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks. We have a limited budget, so we need to ensure every dollar counts.
dialogue.translation: Asante. Tuna fedha kidogo, kwa hiyo tunahitaji kuhakikisha kila dola inafaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Our strategy focuses on digital ads to reach our target audience more effectively.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo. Mikakati yetu inaelekeza kwenye tangazo za kijamii ili kufikia jamii tusudi kwa usafi zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But how can we achieve significant growth with such a small budget?
dialogue.translation: Lakini tunaweza je kufikia upungufu mkubwa kwa fedha kadhaa hivi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the budget is small, we can leverage social media, which is popular among our potential clients.
dialogue.translation: Ingawa fedha ni kidogo, tunaweza kutumia mitandao ya kijamii, ambayo ni maarufu kati ya wageni wetu wa sasa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds promising. What about our current campaigns? Should we replace them?
dialogue.translation: Inaonekana kama ina matumaini. Je, kampeni zetu za sasa? Tunapasa kubadilisha?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We'll adjust them, not replace. Therefore, we can maintain brand consistency while testing new ideas.
dialogue.translation: Tutabadilisha, si kubadilisha. Kwa hiyo, tunaweza kuhifadhi ufanisi wa biashara wakati tunapojaribu mawazo mapya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, I see the potential. Let's discuss this further in our next meeting.
dialogue.translation: Sawa, ninaona uwezo. Tutazungumzia zaidi katika mkutano wetu wa upande.

scenario: Discussing mental health and wellbeing openly
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kama jina (mshirika) na kama kibali (kushirikiana).
Katika mazingatio ya afya ya akili, inamaanisha upweke wa hisia au kimwili.
Kibali kinachotengenezwa kwa kawaida; katika zamani: improved.
Inatumika kwa ajili ya hisia au hisia ndani ya mtu.
Jina lisilo na kipimo; hahusiki 'advices'.
Kibali kinachotengenezwa kwa kawaida; katika zamani: reduced.
Kama sifa inaelezea mtu anaye tayari kushiriki.
Inatumika kuwasilisha uwezo wa kushinda au uwezo wa hisia.
Usichukie na 'lonely' (kushikwa peke yake).
Mwishowe ya jambo linamaanisha 'lakini'.
Inaweza kuelezea muda au sababu.
Inaelezea njia au mbinu ya kufikia kitu chochote.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been feeling a lot of stress lately, but I haven't talked to anyone about it.
dialogue.translation: Nimekuwa na hisia nyingi za matatizo hivi karibuni, lakini sijazungumza na mtu kuhusu hayo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's important to be open about these things. I found that talking to a friend really helps.
dialogue.translation: Ni jambo la maana kuwa wazi kuhusu mambo haya. Nimegundua kuwa kuzungumza na rafiki huko ni wa maana sana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know, but I don't want to burden anyone. I feel I should handle it alone.
dialogue.translation: Najua, lakini sipendi kuweka mtu ye yote katika taabu. Ninahisi kwamba ninapaswa kushughulikia jambo hili peke yangu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're not alone, though. Asking for support is a sign of strength, not weakness.
dialogue.translation: Huwezi kuwa peke yako, lakini. Kushiriki mwingine ni ishara ya nguvu, si udhaifu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Do you have any advice on how to reduce this feeling of being overwhelmed?
dialogue.translation: Ni kweli. Je, una mashauri wowote kuhusu jinsi ya kupunguza hisia hii ya kushindwa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, since exercise works well for me, I try to walk every day. It helps improve my mood.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, tangu michezo inayofaa kwangu, ninajaribu kutembea kila siku. Inasaidia kuboresha hisia zangu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've heard that, but I never seem to find the time. Maybe I can go through a simple routine at home.
dialogue.translation: Nimekisikia hayo, lakini sijawai kupata muda. Labda ninaweza kufuatia utaratibu mkubwa nyumbani.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a good start. Just remember, you don't have to face this alone, and there's always support available.
dialogue.translation: Hii ni mwanzo mwema. Kumbuka tu, huhitaji kushughulikia jambo hili peke yako, na kuna mshirika wa kutosha.

key_phrases.translation: kuwa wazi kuhusu jambo la kitu chochote
kushughulikia jambo la kitu chochote peke yako

scenario: Talking about urban vs rural living
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Utumika mwisho wa jambo kutoa tofauti

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After living in the city for five years, I'm seriously thinking about moving outside the urban area.
dialogue.translation: Baada ya kuishi mjini kwa miaka mitano, ninafikiri kwa uhakika kuhama nje ya eneo la mjini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? I find cities quite convenient — you have access to everything you need within a short walk.
dialogue.translation: Kweli? Ninapata miji ni rahisi sana – una urushi kwa kila kitu unachohitaji kwa njia ya kushuka kwa muda mfupi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but the constant noise and crowded streets drain me. I want a more peaceful environment.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni kweli, lakini sauti za kila mara na mitaa mlaanine hunitahadharisha. Natafuta mazingira yenye amani zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. However, rural areas often lack basic facilities like hospitals or good schools.
dialogue.translation: Nafahamu. Lakini, maeneo ya kijiji mara nyingi hushiki vyombo msingi kama vile hospitali au shule njema.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a fair point. But with remote work, I don't depend on the city for my job anymore.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni point njema. Lakini kwa kazi ya mbali, sina tegemea mjini kwa ajili ya kazi yangu tena.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What about social life and career opportunity? You might feel isolated after a while, though.
dialogue.translation: Je, kuhusu maisha ya kijamii na fursa za kazi? Unaweza kushikwa upweke baada ya muda, ingawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've considered that. But the cost of housing in the city is insane — I can't afford a decent place anymore.
dialogue.translation: Nimefikiria kuhusu hayo. Lakini gharama za nyumba mjini ni kama ujeuri – siwezi kutoa fedha kwa mahali njema tena.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right, it's a real trade-off. Perhaps a small town outside the city could give you the best of both worlds.
dialogue.translation: Una haki, ni ubadilishaji wa kweli. Labda mji mdogo nje ya mjini unaweza kukupa bora za dunia mbili.

scenario: Negotiating a salary or contract term
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Katika mazingira ya kazi, inamaanisha taka la ajira au malipo.
Inaweza kuwa transitivi (kuongeza kitu) au intransitive.
Hutumiwa na preposition 'with' (kutungana na mtu).
Inaelezea kitu ambacho ni haki au inakubaliwa.
Katika kazi, inaweza kuwa faida ya ziada kama afya au likizo.
Mara nyingi inatumika jamovi kuelezea masharti ya mkataba.
Kukubali taka au mapendekezo.
Inaonyesha uwezo au shaka.
Mara nyingi inamaanisha kiwango cha fedha.
Maana ni hitaji au kushutumu kitu.
Hutumiwa kuelezea kwamba kitu ni sehemu ya kitu kingine.
Hutumiwa mwisho wa jambo kama 'lakini'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you for the offer, but I’d like to negotiate the salary.
dialogue.translation: Asante kwa taka lako, lakini ninataka kutungana kwa malipo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We think the amount we proposed is reasonable, though.
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Tunadhani kiwango tulichotaka ni haki, lakini.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but I’d like a 10% increase because the position requires more responsibility.
dialogue.translation: Nafahamu, lakini ninataka kuongezwa 10% kwa sababu nafasi hii inahitaji jukumu zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we can adjust the salary if you accept a longer contract term.
dialogue.translation: Labda tunaweza kubadilisha malipo ikiwa ukikubali muda mrefu wa mkataba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That could work, but please include a clause about annual reviews in the conditions.
dialogue.translation: Inaweza kufanya kazi, lakini tafadhali weka kipande kuhusu uchunguzi kila mwaka katika masharti.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We can do that. Also, we’ll add a health benefit package to the offer.
dialogue.translation: Tunaweza fanya hivyo. Pia, tutaweka pakoti ya faida za afya katika taka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. If the benefit package is included, I’ll accept the terms.
dialogue.translation: Nzuri. Ikiwa pakoti ya faida imewekwa, nitakubali masharti.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I’ll send the final contract for you to review.
dialogue.translation: Kamilifu. Nitakutuma mkataba wa mwisho ili uichunguze.

scenario: Debating environmental policy with a peer
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kuelezea mada au tatizo muhimu.
Kumbukumbu cha kanuni au mikakati ya hatua, hapa katika mazingira ya serikali au ya taasisi.
Fili za kisasa; katika makusanyiko huonekana katika sura ya msingi.
Chanzo cha kitu chochote; katika halua hii, chanzo cha nishati.
Bei au gharama; inaweza kuwa kiuchumi au katika maana mengine.
Inaelezea mazingira ya asili au ya kimwili.
Sehemu ya kiuchumi inayoshughulikia uzalishaji wa bidhaa au huduma.
Fili hii; inaonekana katika sura ya msingi na katika infinitive.
Hutumiwa kama sifa au kama kifasi kuelezea uwezo wa kutokea.
Kifasi cha kubainisha tofauti; huwa linatoka mwanzo au katikati ya jamlani.
Inaelezea upinzani au uhusiano wa kushikamana.
Kifasi cha kubainisha ule jambo unaotokana na kile kilichosema kabla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue with the new policy is that it's too expensive for small businesses.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri tatizo kubwa zaidi na polisi jipya ni kwamba ni gharama zaidi kwa biashara ndogo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But we have to reduce our emissions somehow. The environment is at stake, and we can't just ignore that.
dialogue.translation: Lakini lazima tupunguze utatizo wetu kwa njia yo yeyote. Mazingira yana hatari, na hatuwezi kuiignorea hilo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but the cost of switching to renewable sources will hurt the industry in the short term.
dialogue.translation: Nanafaa, lakini gharama za kubadilisha kwenye chanzo za nishati zinazotengenezwa zitaadhikaa industria katika muda mfupi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: However, if we delay, the long-term damage will be even worse. We need to act now.
dialogue.translation: Hata hivyo, ikiwa tutapanda, hasara ya muda mrefu itakuwa mbaya zaidi. Lazima tishiriki sasa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but are you against any kind of compromise? Maybe we can phase in the changes slowly.
dialogue.translation: Ni kweli, lakini je, unawakilisha upinzani wa aina yoyote? Labda tunaweza kuanzisha mabadiliko pole pole.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not against compromise, but the current plan is too weak. Although I understand your concern about jobs, we need stricter targets.
dialogue.translation: Sina upinzani na mawazo ya kushirikiana, lakini mpango wa sasa ni dhaifu sana. Ingawa ninafahamu wasiwasi wako kuhusu ajira, tunahitaji malengo makali zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I still think it's a risky move. The economic impact is likely to be severe, especially for rural areas.
dialogue.translation: Vyema, bado ninataka ni hatua yenye hatari. Athari ya kiuchumi ina uwezo mkubwa wa kuwa mbaya, hasa katika maeneo ya kijiji.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And I believe it's a necessary risk. If we don't act, future generations will face a much harder problem.
dialogue.translation: Na mimi ninakusudia ni hatari ya lazima. Ikiwa hatutashiriki, kundi za kusudi zitakuta tatizo kubwa zaidi.

scenario: Discussing immigration and identity
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuelezea hisia ya kuwa sehemu katika sehemu au kikundi fulani.
Inamaanisha hisia ya kuwa mtu ni nani, hasa katika mazingatio ya kiutamaduni.
Inatumika kuelezea historia ya familia, kiutamaduni au elimu ya mtu fulani.
Inaashiria mila, maana na desturi za kikundi fulani.
Kubadilisha kulingana na mazingatio au mazingatio mapya.
Kuingiaa kwa kawaida katika jamii au kikundi fulani.
Kutoa uzito wa kutosha katika sehemu mbili tofauti.
Inatumika kama 'a sense of' kuelezea maana au hisia.
Mwenendo au njia ya kufikiri na kufanya.
Kutoa thamani jambo au mtu fulani.
Inatumika kuelezea tofauti: 'despite something'.
Kama ishara inamaanisha 'ingawa'; mwishowe wa jambo inamaanisha 'lakini'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After living here for years, I still sometimes feel like I don't belong.
dialogue.translation: Baada ya kuishi hapa kwa miaka, wakati mwingine bado ninahisi si niko sehemu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know what you mean. My identity is split between my parents' culture and this new place.
dialogue.translation: Ninajua unamaana nini. Utambulisho wangu umeakagazwa kati utamaduni wa wazazi wangu na mahali mapa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How do you manage to balance both? I find it hard to keep my background while adapting.
dialogue.translation: Unajenga nini kutaratibu mbili? Ninahisi ni vigevu kuhifadhi historia yangu wakati wa kutia.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It takes effort. I try to integrate into the community without losing my roots.
dialogue.translation: Inahitaji juhudi. Ninajikija kuingiaa katika jamii bila kufutwa mazingatio yangu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That gives me a sense of hope, but sometimes my attitude gets in the way.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo inanihisisha tumaini, lakini wakati mwingine mtazamo wangu unakuzana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I value the way you're trying, though. It's not easy for anyone.
dialogue.translation: Ninakudhihirisha njia unajikija, ingawa. Si rahisi kwa yeyote.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite all the challenges, I feel more at home now than before.
dialogue.translation: Kwa kuwa na changamoto zote, sasa ninahisi ni nyumbani zaidi kuliko zamu.

scenario: Analyzing a piece of art or literature
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kusema kuhusuza au kiongozo kinachotolewa na kazi.
Hutumiwa kuelezea tofauti zaidi.
Inaweza kumaana mtu au umbo wa kazi.
Katika uchambuzi, maana yake ni jinsi ya kufikia mada.
Kusudi la mwanasheria au ya maandiko.
Inaonesha kuwa kitu chochote, bila ubaguzi.
Kutoa maana ya fikra au hisia.
Pia inaweza kuwa 'mchango', lakini hapa hutumika kama hatua.
Kitu kinachotoa ishara kuhusu maana.
Kufika mwisho wa uchambuzi.
Inaelezea kitu ambacho haikuwepo kwa muda mrefu.
Hutumiwa kusema kuhusu kitu kilichokuwa kabla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you think this figure in the foreground is supposed to represent?
dialogue.translation: Unafikiria hii umbo ulio mwishini unataka kutoa maana gani?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think it might express a sense of loss, especially when you look at the way its hand is placed.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri inaweza kutoa maana ya ukame, hasa unapo ulimwengu wake umewekwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but let's approach it from a different angle. Maybe the entire scene is about a particular historical event.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini tufikie kwa njia tofauti. Labda mchanganyiko mzima unahusuza tukio la historia tofauti.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a good point. The colors and the lighting could be a sign of that era, like a former war period.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni sehemu njema. Rangi na mwangaza huweza kuwa ishara ya kipindi hicho, kama kipindi cha vita kilichopita.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So you're saying the artist's purpose was to document history, not just to create beauty?
dialogue.translation: Hivyo unasema kuwa kusudi la mwanasheria ulikuwa kuhifadhi historia, si tu kufanya uzuri?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. At this stage of the analysis, I think we can conclude that the painting is a commentary on conflict.
dialogue.translation: Ndivyo hivyo. Katika hatua hii ya uchambuzi, nafikiri tunaweza kufika kwenye kuwa upande wa mchanganyiko ni maoni kuhusuza mgogoro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's take a brief look at the background, just to confirm that idea.
dialogue.translation: Tufanye upande wa nyuma kwa upande wa muda mfupi, tuathibitisha fikra hiyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. After a brief review, I agree with your conclusion.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo. Baada ya kufanya tena la muda mfupi, ninafikiri na kwenye wako.

key_phrases.phrase: approach it from a different angle
at this stage of the analysis

scenario: Discussing the gig economy and job insecurity
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuelezea kazi imara au hali isiyo na hatari.
Fedha inayopatikana kutoka kwenye kazi au uwekezaji.
Inaongeza tofauti katika jambo linilosemwa.
Inaweza kubadilika kwa urahisi kulingana na mabadiliko ya muda au masharti.
Kumuopa mtu kazi, kwa kawaida kwa muda mfupi au daima.
Mtu au kampuni inayotoa kazi.
Kutoa kitu kinachohitajika.
Manufaa ya ziada, kama afya au likizo linazolopwa.
Uwezo wa kutokea jambo la suala.
Makubaliano ya kimashirika kati ya mwajiri na mtu anayeshughulikia.
Neno inayotumiwa kuelezea tofauti.
Kwa kuelezea uwezo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm thinking about leaving my full-time job to do freelance work, but I'm not sure if it's secure enough.
dialogue.translation: Ninafikiri kushuka kazini yangu ya muda mzima ili nifanye kazi isiyo ya kawaida, lakini sina uhakika kama ni salama kutosha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. The gig economy gives you more flexible hours, but your income can change every month.
dialogue.translation: Ninaelewa. Uchumi wa kazi za muda unfanya iwe na masaa yenye uwezo wa kubadilika zaidi, lakini mapato yako yanaweza kubadilika kila mwezi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Although the money is sometimes better, I worry about the lack of benefits like health insurance.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni kweli. Ingawa fedha ni bora zaidi wakati mwingine, ninahuzunika kuhusu ukosefu wa manufaa kama afya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, many companies hire gig workers without any contract, so they don't provide any benefits at all.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, makampuni mengi huajiri wafanyikazi wa kazi za muda bila ya makubaliano yoyote, hivyo hutoi manufaa yoyote.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And as an independent worker, you have to take on more risk because you don't have an employer to rely on.
dialogue.translation: Na kama mtu anayeshughulikia peke yake, unahitaji kushikamana na hatari zaidi kwa sababu huna mwajiri unayeweza kumuamini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. Maybe it's better to keep a part-time job for stability while you build your freelance career.
dialogue.translation: Ndio hivyo. Labda ni bora zaidi kuhifadhi kazi ya muda mfupi kwa ustawi wakati unajenga miradi yako ya kazi isiyo ya kawaida.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea. I'll think about it, although I still prefer the idea of being my own boss.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni fikra njema. Nitafikiri kuhusu hiyo, ingawa bado ninapenda mawazo ya kuwa mfalme wangu mwenyewe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Whatever you decide, just remember to save money for the months when you don't have a steady income.
dialogue.translation: Kila kitu unachokiketa, kumbuka tu kuhifadhi fedha kwa miezi ambayo huna mapato ya kawaida.

key_phrases.translation: uchumi wa kazi za muda / uchumi wa kushiriki

scenario: Talking about political systems abstractly
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Matumizi ya kiamani: uwezo wa kisiasa au uwezo wa kushikamana.
Inaendana na watu kwa ujumla au serikali.
Mtu moja, au jambo lililo linalohusiana na mtu mmoja.
Kushikamana na jambo la kituo au mtu; pia msaada.
Kazini au nafasi ya kitu au mtu katika mfumo.
Kitu ambacho ni kwa umili au kinatokea mara nyingi.
Kanuni iliyowekwa na mamlaka.
Kiongozi cha mantiki kinachoonesha matokeo.
Sehemu inayojenga kitu cha kawaida.
Moja tu, bila nyinginezo.
Chaguo kati ya mikakati.
Kumbukumbu cha sehemu zilizoandaliwa kazi pamoja.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In a democratic system, the power comes from the public, but how much power does each individual actually have?
dialogue.translation: Katika mfumo wa kidemokrasia, nguvu inatoka kwa umma, lakini nguvu ngapi kila mtu ana kwa kweli?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think the individual's role is mainly to support the system by voting, but the real decisions are made by a small group.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri kazi ya mtu ni kuwashikamana na mfumo kupitia kutoa kura, lakini maamuzi ya kweli yanatengenezwa na kikundi kidogo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yet, a single vote can influence a decision, especially in a close election, so every vote counts.
dialogue.translation: Hata hivyo, kura moja inaweza kubadilisha maamuzi, hasa katika uchaguzi unaokaribia, hivyo kila kura inahesabiwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That is true, but the law often protects the interests of the powerful, and therefore, the common person may feel left out.
dialogue.translation: Hivyo ni kweli, lakini sheria mara nyingi huhifadhi maslahi ya wenye nguvu, na kwa hiyo, mtu wa kawaida aweza kuhisi kuwa ameshachukuliwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, is the public just a part of the machine, or can they truly shape the system?
dialogue.translation: Hivyo, je, umma ni sehemu tu ya mashine, au wanaweza kweli kubadilisha mfumo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I believe the system is designed to balance power, but it only works if the public actively participates.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri mfumo umeandaliwa kuweka uzito wa nguvu, lakini hufanya kazi tu endapo umma hushiriki kwa ufanisi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then the role of each individual is not just to vote, but to hold their leaders accountable.
dialogue.translation: Ndipo kazi ya kila mtu si tu kutoa kura, bali pia kuwahusisha viongozi wake katika majukumu yao.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly, and without that support, the common good is often ignored in favor of private interests.
dialogue.translation: Ndivyo hivyo, na bila msaada huo, mema ya umma mara nyingi hutengenezwa kwa ajili ya maslahi ya binafsi.

scenario: Describing a complex technical process
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuelezea mbinu au hatua za kufanya jambo fulani.
Rasmi, kama 'hitaji'.
Inatumika na malengo au matukio.
Njia ya kufanya jambo fulani.
Kinyume na 'jumla'.
Inaweza kuwa sharti au hali ya kitu fulani.
Kufanya au kutengeneza kitu fulani.
Kuhifadhi kitu ndani.
Kutoa ruhusa au kufanya jambo fulani iwezekane.
Inaonyesha muda ulipoendelea jambo fulani.
Kiongozi cha mawazo kinaelezea matokeo.
Aina mbalimbali za kitu fulani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm trying to understand the new manufacturing process, but it seems quite complex.
dialogue.translation: Nina jaribu kuelewa mchakato mpya wa uzalishaji, lakini inaonekana kuwa vigumu sana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It does require careful attention to detail at every step.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, inahitaji makini sana katika kila hatua.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What is the main method they use to achieve such a specific result?
dialogue.translation: Ni njia gani wanayotumia kufikia matokeo kama hayo yanayohusiana na jambo fulani?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: They first create a controlled condition of high pressure and temperature.
dialogue.translation: Kwanza hutoa hali inayokawazwa ya pweke na joto kubwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, that allows them to produce a material that can contain the energy?
dialogue.translation: Hivyo, hutoa nafasi ya kufanya dhana inayoweza kuhifadhi nishati?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. During that phase, they also add various catalysts to speed things up.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo. Katika kipindi hicho, pia huongeza vichakato tofauti ili kushikisha mambo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Therefore, the temperature must be monitored constantly to avoid failure.
dialogue.translation: Kwa hiyo, joto lazima ufunguziwe kwa daima ili kuhakikisha kwamba hakuna tatizo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and any slight variation in that condition can ruin the entire batch.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, na mabadiliko wowote ndani ya hali hiyo inaweza kuharibu kila kitu.

key_phrases.translation: kufikia matokeo yanayohusiana na jambo fulani

scenario: Discussing the ethics of AI
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kusema kuhusu jambo au tatizo muhimu.
Habari inayothibitisha kitu chochote.
Inatumika kabla ya jina kushowisha kwamba kitu kinaweza kutokea.
Ubore wa kivuruge kwa ajili au dhidi ya kitu au mtu.
Kukubali kitu kama kweli bila uhakika wa kutosha.
Kufanya mabadiliko au kuharibu kitu chochote.
Inatumika kushowisha kwamba kuna uhakika mkubwa kwamba kitu kinaweza kutokea.
Kufahamu au kujua kuhusu kitu chochote.
Moja ya sababu inayochangia matokeo.
Kufanya kitu kiwe salama au kweli.
Mtu anayepewa jukumu la kufanya kazi kwa njia iliyo sahihi.
Inaonyesha kwamba kitu kimefika zaidi ya kipindi au mwisho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The biggest issue with AI in hiring is that it might have a hidden bias.
dialogue.translation: Tatizo kubwa zaidi na AI katika ajira ni kwamba inaweza kuwa na ubore wa kivuruge ulio fisadi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you have any evidence for that? I think AI can actually reduce human bias.
dialogue.translation: Je, una uhakika wowote wa kile? Nayofikiri kwamba AI inaweza kufanya ubore wa kivuruge wa binadamu upunguze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: There are studies showing that AI systems often learn from past data that includes bias, so they can affect certain groups unfairly.
dialogue.translation: Kuna utafiti unayoonyesha kwamba mfumo wa AI mara nyingi hujifunza kutoka kwa data za zamani ambazo zina ubore wa kivuruge, hivyo wanaweza kufanya madhara kwa vikundi fulani bila haki.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see, but we should also consider the potential benefits for efficiency. However, we must be aware of the risks.
dialogue.translation: Nafahamu, lakini tunapaswa pia kufikiri kuhusu faida za kiweza kwa ajili ya utendaji. Hata hivyo, tunapaswa kuwa na ujuzi kuhusu hatari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True, but efficiency isn't the only factor. We also have to ensure that AI decisions are fair and transparent.
dialogue.translation: Kweli, lakini utendaji siyo jambo la pamoja. Tunapaswa pia kuhakikisha kwamba maamuzi ya AI yana haki na wazi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Who is responsible if an AI makes a wrong decision? The developer, the company, or the AI itself?
dialogue.translation: Ni nani mwenye jukumu ikiwa AI inafanya uamuzi mbaya? Mchapishaji, kampuni, au AI mwenyewe?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a key question. We can't assume the AI is neutral, because it's designed by people with their own values.
dialogue.translation: Hii ni swali muhimu. Hatwezi kufikiri kwamba AI ni wastani, kwa sababu imeundwa na watu wenye maamuliko yao wenyewe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. The debate goes beyond just technology; it's about our society and the future we want to build.
dialogue.translation: Bilashaka. Majaribio haya yanaenda zaidi ya teknolojia tu; inahusu jamii zetu na mustakabali tunayotaka kujenga.

key_phrases.translation: kuwa na ubore wa kivuruge ulio fisadi

key_phrases.phrase: ensure that AI decisions are fair
key_phrases.translation: kuhakikisha kwamba maamuzi ya AI yana haki

scenario: Talking about gender roles and change
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kusema kuhusu utawala au mwenendo wa mtu.
Kama jina, maana yake ni mabadiliko au kubadilisha.
Feli inayotumika kutoa nguvu au kushikisha kitu.
Ina maana ya kile kinachotazamiwa kwa mtu au kitu.
Katika mazingira haya, ina maana ya ubunifu au majaribu kutoka kwa jamii au familia.
Inatumika kutoa ujumbe kuhusu usawa katika haki au matratasi.
Feli nyingi inayotumika kusambaza kwa usawa.
Ina maana ya uhuru wa kuchagua.
Neno isiyo na mbadala inayotumiwa katika muda wa sasa.
Neno isiyo na mbadala inayotumiwa kutoa ujumbe kuhusu ukomoji au changamoto.
Kama neno isiyo na mbadala, inatumika mwisho wa jambo ili kutoa maelezo.
Neno inayounganisha kinachotoa mfano wa kile cha kushangaza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've noticed a real shift in attitudes about gender roles at work, haven't you?
dialogue.translation: Nimeona mabadiliko ya kweli katika mwenendo kuhusu kazi za kijinsia kazini, je, huku?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, nowadays it's hardly acceptable to make jokes that were common ten years ago.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, siku hizi ni vigumu kufurahia mzaha ulio wa kawaida miaka kumi iliyopita.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True, but I still feel pressure to act in a certain way, especially as a man in a leadership position.
dialogue.translation: Kweli, lakini bado ninahisi ubunifu wa kufanya jambo fulani, hasa kama mwanaume katika nafasi ya kiongozi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think the expectation is changing, though. My company now encourages fathers to take paternity leave.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri kile kinachotazamiwa kinabadilika, hata hivyo. Kampuni yangu sasa inawashikisha wazazi kuweka muda wa baba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's great, but unless men actually take the leave, the policy doesn't mean much.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni jambo la kufurahia, lakini iwapo wanaume hawawatii kipato, siasa hii hauna maana mengi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly, and that's why we need to share responsibilities equally at home too.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo hivyo, na hii ndiyo sababu tunahitaji kushiriki majukumu kwa usawa nyumbani pia.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but it's not always a free choice for everyone; some people face strong family pressure.
dialogue.translation: Natifu, lakini si daima ni uchaguzi wa kila mmoja; watu fulani huharriri ubunifu mkubwa kutoka kwa familia.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's keep pushing for change, then. Every small step counts.
dialogue.translation: Basi tuendelee kushikisha mabadiliko, ndipo kila hatua ndogo inahusisha.

key_phrases.phrase: unless men actually take the leave

scenario: Reflecting on a life-changing experience
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inayotumika kwa kawaida na 'that' kuelezaa kufikia ujuzi wa kitu chochote.
Inayotumika kuweka uzuri kwamba kitu chochote ni kamilifu au jumla.
Kwa kawaida katika madhumuni kama vile 'kupata kusudi wako' au 'kwenda kwa kusudi'.
Inayotumika kuweka tofauti. Tikio: neno hili lilikuwa katika orodha ya kutekelezwa, lakini nitabadilisha baadaye - nitatumia 'though' badala yake.
Inayotumika kuweka tofauti, mara nyingi mwisho wa habari.
Inaweza kuelezea umuhimu au thamani. Katika jamii 'values' maana ya kanuni.
Inayotumika kwa kubali hali na kubali mawazo.
Inaelezea kumbukumbu au uwezo wa kumbukumbu wa akili.
Katika mazingira haya, tukio au hali muhimu ulioathiri.
Inayotumika kuweka tofauti. (Tikio: Sitatumia hii kwa sababu ya orodha ya kutekelezwa - nitatumia 'though')
Inayotumika kuelezaa hatua zote.
Inaweza kuelezea nguvu za kimwili au nguvu za hisia.
Kwa kawaida inatumika kama ishara ya maendeleo ya kibinadamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After that trip, I began to realize that my life had changed entirely.
dialogue.translation: Baada ya safari hiyo, nilianza kuelewa kwamba maisha yangu yaliharibika kwa ukweli.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I know what you mean. I found a new purpose in my work, though it was not easy.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, najua ulimwengu wako. Nimepata kusudi mpya katika kazi yangu, ingawa kulikuwa vigumu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Now I value every moment, and I accept that some things are beyond my control.
dialogue.translation: Sasa ninathamini kila mara, na ninabali kwamba vitu vingi ni zaidi ya uwezo wangu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That is a strong memory for you, I suppose. It gave you strength.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni kumbukumbu hodari kwa ajili yako, nadhani. Ilikupa nguvu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That experience taught me to continue even when things get hard.
dialogue.translation: Ndio hivyo. Uzoefu huo uliniambia kuendelea hata wakati mambo yanapokuwa vigumu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I feel the same. It was a period of personal growth for both of us.
dialogue.translation: Nina hisia kama yako. Ilikuwa kipindi cha kuongezeka kwa kibinadamu kwa ajili yetu wote.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Indeed. Looking back, I am grateful for the whole journey.
dialogue.translation: Ndio hivyo. Kuelekea nyuma, ninashukuru safari yote.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So am I. We should talk about it more often, but perhaps not today.
dialogue.translation: Mimi pia. Tunapaswa kusema kuhusu hilo mara nyingi zaidi, lakini si leo.

scenario: Discussing the role of humor in communication
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kusema kuhusu kipimo au nguvu za jambo fulani.
Kukuza au kushuka mtu/jambo fulani.
Katika mazingira, maana yake ni 'kuonekana' (to seem) au 'kutokea' (to show up).
Kukabiliana na mada au hali kwa njia fulani.
Kinachotokea bila uharibifu au kinachokuwa kikali sana.
Kuendelea kuhifadhi jambo fulani (mahusiano, tabia, n.k).
Kinacholetea matokeo mema au tabia njema.
Inaonyesha kwamba jambo fulani ni la kawaida kutokea.
Hutumiwa kutoa maelezo kwa kisa cha kutoa uzoefu (bastante) au kutoa utaratibu (más bien).
Inaonyesha kwamba jambo fulani linaendelea zaidi ya kipindi au sehemu fulani.
Mwishowe wa jambo, maana yake ni 'lakini' au 'hata ingawa'. (Tazama: hapa hahutumiwi kama mstari).
Inaonyesha sharti lazima lililopasa ili jambo fulani litoke.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think humor has a huge impact on communication, but its success depends on the degree of trust between people.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri furaha ina athari kubwa kwenye mawasiliano, lakini mafanikio yake huamini kwenye kipimo cha imani kati ya watu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. If you don't know someone well, you should avoid jokes that could be misinterpreted.
dialogue.translation: Bilashaka. Ikiwa hujui mtu vizuri, unapaswa kushuka vituo vilivyoweza kuelezewa vibaya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. A joke might appear funny to you, but it can seem offensive to the other person.
dialogue.translation: Sahi. Vituo vinaweza kuonekana kama vinafurahisha kwako, lakini vinaweza kuonekana kama vinaongea mtu mwingine vibaya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, how do you approach humor at work, then? I find that a light joke can make the atmosphere more positive.
dialogue.translation: Hivyo, unakutana na furaha kazini? Ninapata kwamba vituo vidogo vinaweza kufanya mazingira kuwa bora zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to use it, but the immediate reaction is not always good. Sometimes people just stare at you.
dialogue.translation: Nina jaribu kuweka, lakini madawa ya mara moja hayana mema. Mara nyingi watu wanakutana na wewe tu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right. I think the key is to maintain a balance. Don't force it, and read the room first.
dialogue.translation: Sawa. Nafikiri ufunguo ni kuhifadhi usawa. Usijaribu kufanya, na soma chumba kwanza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. If you do it too often, your colleagues will likely stop taking you seriously, though.
dialogue.translation: Kweli. Ikiwa unafanya mara nyingi, wafanyakazi wako watakoma kukuza wewe kwa ujasiri, lakini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, humor is rather powerful. It goes beyond simple laughter. It builds bonds, but unless you are careful, it can also break them.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, furaha ni yenye nguvu zaidi. Inaendelea zaidi ya kucheka tu. Inabina uhusiano, lakini usipokuwa mwenye kujali, inaweza kufanya uhusiano kuwa mbaya.

scenario: Presenting a research finding
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kushirikisha kwamba matokeo ni ya maana au siyo ya kusababishwa na siri.
Hutumiwa katika jamii katika Kiingereza cha kijamii.
Feli regular, mwisho -yze (andiko la Marekani).
Katika utafiti, kikundi cha watu au bidhaa zilizochunguzwa.
Hutumiwa na 'to': similar to.
Hutumiwa na 'to' au 'with'.
Mara nyingi katika jamii: results.
Katika sayansi, maana kugundua kitu kwa njia ya hisia au vyombo.
Mifano ya mabadiliko au mwongozo wa umumi.
Kifano cha njia, kinabadilisha kifano.
Hutumiwa na 'to': according to.
Huanza ufwani au tofauti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've finished analyzing the data from our latest survey. Do you want to see the results?
dialogue.translation: Nimefinisha kuchunguza data kutoka kwenye uchunguzi wetu wa mwisho. Unataka kuona matokeo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Did you compare the responses from the two different age groups?
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, tafadhali! Ulikabiliana utumiani kutoka kwenye vikundi mbili mbalimbali vya umri?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. According to the initial figures, the younger group shows a significant increase in usage.
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Kwa kuweka kwenye nambari za kwanza, kikundi cha kijani kinachukua uongezaji mkubwa wa matumizi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's interesting. Did you observe any other notable patterns in that sample?
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni ya kufurahisha. Ulikuta mifano yo yoyote ya kumbuka katika mifano huo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we saw a clear trend: the older group's numbers remained stable, although they started from a higher point.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, tuliona mifano ya waziwazi: nambari za kikundi cha wazee zilikawa zimebaki, ingawa walianza kutoka kwenye sehemu ambayo ni juu zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So the findings are quite similar to last year's study, but with a sharper contrast in the younger demographic.
dialogue.translation: Hivyo matokeo ni sawa na uchunguzi wa mwaka uliopita, lakini na tofauti kubwa zaidi katika jamii ya vijana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. This clearly demonstrates that our new approach is working as intended.
dialogue.translation: Sawa. Hii hutoa uhakika kwamba mbinu yetu mpya inaendelea kama tulivyotaka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Excellent. Let's prepare the final report and present these findings to the team tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Vema. Tutayarishie taarifa mwisho na toa matokeo haya kwa timu kesho.

key_phrases.translation: kwa kuweka kwenye nambari za kwanza

scenario: Discussing inequality and social mobility
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inaelezea fedha inayopokelewa kwa ajili ya kazi au uwekezaji.
Tofauti au mbali kati ya jambo mbili, hapa kati ya wataalam wa kiuchumi na washirika.
Hali inayotokana inayowezesha kufikia lengo fulani.
Mazingira ya kijamii au ya familia ya mtu.
Inaonyesha tofauti; hutumika na jina la kiwanja au mstari.
Kiongozi kinachoonesha matokeo.
Kiongozi kinachoonesha tofauti.
Kufanya jambo fulani kuwa bora zaidi.
Kufanya juhudi kubwa ili kufikia lengo fulani.
Kuinua au hamia juu.
Inaendana na jamii.
Kiwango kikubwa cha fedha au mali.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been reading about the income gap in our country, and it's shocking how wide it has become.
dialogue.translation: Nimekuwa nikisoma kuhusu ubaguzi wa mapato katika nchi yetu, na ni kishangaza jinsi ulivyoongezeka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but the real problem is the lack of opportunity for those from a poor background to improve their situation.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini tatizo kweli ni ukosefu wa fursa kwa wale kutoka katika mazingira ya umaskini ili kuboresha hali yao.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite all the talk about equal rights, many people still struggle to get a decent job.
dialogue.translation: Kwa kawaida, watu wengi bado wanapambana kupata kazi njema, hata kama huko ni maelezo mengi kuhusu haki sawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Therefore, social mobility is almost impossible for them; they remain stuck in the same class.
dialogue.translation: Kwa hiyo, uhamiaji wa kijamii ni karibu haiwezekani kwao; hupambazuka katika daraja moja.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: However, I know a few cases where people managed to rise despite their humble beginnings.
dialogue.translation: Hata hivyo, najua mifano michache ambayo watu walifanikisha kushinda hata kuanzia mwanzo wao wa kawaida.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But those are rare exceptions; the wealth is concentrated in a few hands, and that's the core issue.
dialogue.translation: Lakini hayo ni istithnaat nafedha imewekwa katika mikono michache, na hiyo ndiyo swali la msingi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, what can we do to change this? Maybe better education is the answer.
dialogue.translation: Hivyo, tunaweza kufanya nini ili kubadilisha hii? Labda elimu bora ni jibu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Education helps, but we also need policies that directly address the gap, otherwise nothing will really change.
dialogue.translation: Elimu inasaidia, lakini tunahitaji pia sera zinazohusiana na ubaguzi wa mapato, kwa njia nyingine hakuna kitu kitakayobadilika.

scenario: Talking about leadership styles
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuwongoza kikundi au mradi.
Njia isiyo badilika ya kufanya jambo fulani.
Kuonyesha waziwazi jambo la kufanya.
Kusaidia au kushikamana na mtu fulani.
Chagua kati ya mawazo mbalimbali.
Kikundi cha watu wanachokabiliana kazi.
Kuwongoza au kuwashirikisha kikundi.
Uwezo au haki ya kufanya uamuzi.
Wenye uwezo wa kubadilika kwa mabadiliko.
Inayohusisha kuweka sharti ngumu.
Majukumu ya kufanya jambo fulani au kuhifadhi jambo fulani.
Inayotoa matokeo yanayotakiwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the best way to manage a project is to be flexible with your team.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri njia bora zaidi ya kuwongoza mradi ni kuwa na uwezo wa kubadilika na kikundi lako.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But if you're too flexible, people may not take their responsibility seriously.
dialogue.translation: Lakini kama wewe ni mwenye kubadilika sana, watu hawajui kuhifadhi majukumu yao kwa uhakika.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I prefer to lead by supporting others rather than giving strict orders.
dialogue.translation: Ninapenda kuwongoza kwa kuwashirikisha wengine kuliko kuwapa amri ngumu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In my experience, a leader must have authority and make decisions quickly.
dialogue.translation: Kwa mujaribuni wangu, mwenyeji anapaswa kuwa na uwezo na kufanya uamuzi haraka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the most effective leaders direct without being authoritarian.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini viongozi bora zaidi huhusisha watu bila kuwa na uwezo mkubwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right. A strict style can work, but it may not be the best for every team.
dialogue.translation: Labda una haki. Njia ya kuweka sharti ngumu inaweza kufanya kazi, lakini isingeweza kuwa bora zaidi kwa kila kikundi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. So, how do you usually manage conflict within your team?
dialogue.translation: Ndivyo hivyo. Hivyo, unavyoongoza mshindo ndani ya kikundi lako?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to support each person and give them more responsibility when they're ready.
dialogue.translation: Ninajikinga kuwashirikisha kila mtu na kuwapa majukumu zaidi wakati wao wako tayari.
